name: print-social-orange-vocab-drop-with-pixel-icons
title: Orange vocab post with lavender pill, arrows and pixel icons
whatItIs: A 4:5 post on grainy orange paper. A lavender pill with dark green border holds the title. A centred photo of a bag and scrunchie is surrounded by cut-out hair accessories with white curved arrows pointing to details, pixel art butterfly, flower and sunglasses stickers, and a two-line green caption below.
whatItMeans: Girly, playful and instructive; arrows make it work like an annotated diagram.
techniques: Point curved white arrows from isolated objects to the photo details they name.
Use warm orange with dark green type for a distinctive earthy-pop palette.
Mix pixel-art stickers with real photos.
Add fine horizontal grain lines to imitate paper.

vocabulary.definition: A hand-drawn arrow linking a label or object to a detail.
Mixing earth tones with bright pastels.
Fine noise lines mimicking printed paper.
Items arranged around a central image.
